findings.title: Correct fractional totals are rejected by binary-float equality
findings.detail: With authoritative synthetic past-due amounts 510.10, 1320.20 and 140.30, the conforming total:1970.60 proposal is rejected as aggregate allocation because Python sum is 1970.6000000000001. A second independent cents fixture totals 600.60 but sums to 600.5999999999999. Both valid full-amount controls reach joint readback. The fault asks for unnecessary allocation, increments format, and grants no write permission. This is present in the exact B12 export; regression timing is not established.
findings.recommended_change: Use exact decimal monetary comparison or integer minor units for aggregate reconciliation; retain explicit allocation, whole-frame validation, and fresh consent guards. Do not recover numeric amounts from raw speech.

findings.title: Bounded format failure closes Brief B without required product notes
findings.detail: After identity and get_account succeed, four END-plus-admin contaminated scalar frames increment format to 4. The engine routes directly to farewell with no_promise/service_error while every returned product remains open and no add_note was dispatched. Brief B rule 8 explicitly requires a note for every product without a promise, including when none gets a promise. Fail-closed non-writing is correct; the normal verified completion path is missing required dispositions. This is a conditional CPU witness, not an observed B12 hosted call.
findings.recommended_change: At the known verified format-exhaustion boundary, preserve recorded promises and uncommitted evidence, assign an allowed service_error disposition to unresolved products, and use guarded add_note receipts before closing. Preserve the complete prohibition on notes when transferring. No malformed financial payload should be salvaged.

findings.title: Scalar-only instructions and fresh confirmation preserve strict consumption
findings.detail: Each event/raw_speech/admin variable now asks only for its own scalar string. Event explicitly forbids JSON wrappers, sibling labels and any suffix after END, has 6287 description characters, and no per-variable extraction_prompt. Prior B4 review described a 9851-character description plus a conflicting envelope instruction. All 21 B12 literal examples pass the exported decoder. Contaminated/missing/unknown-tag/duplicate/oversize/stale-authority financial frames cannot create a promise. Pure malformed confirmation preserves immutable readback and asks the short fresh question; later conforming consent dispatches once. Producer behavior was not sampled, so elimination of hosted contamination is unproved.

findings.title: Joint consent, corrections, siblings and per-product offer chronology remain guarded
findings.detail: Both mixed row orders preserve card 510/2026-10-15. Loan offers remain 1320/2026-10-16 then 440/2026-10-23; the early car gets exactly one 140/2026-10-16 offer. The initial B aggregate ask leaves all per-product attempt counters at zero. Paused/withdrawn/incomplete consent blocks same-turn writes without deleting siblings. Partial joint confirmation is insufficient; a completed correction gets a new readback and needs later consent. Quoted/unrelated paid controls use unknown as the producer contract requires. Tail AI/scam/unknown questions preserve primary facts, while balance/readback questions pause final consent. These are conditional semantic-frame tests, not an extraction model accuracy claim.

findings.title: Receipt binding and narrowly fresh 500 retry retain exact terms
findings.detail: The exact exported API pre/post hooks were executed with synthetic response data. Three successful promises each dispatch once, and recorded language/SMS follows receipts. Explicit false or receipt-matched no-post-hook HTTP 500 with a strictly increased failure counter and unchanged success counter permits one identical-terms retry; a second fresh failure exhausts at two writes. Stale counters, concurrent success delta, other status, unknown outcome or stale receipt cannot authorize blind retries. Request serials change for retries, so this proves client term preservation and policy write limits rather than a server idempotency-key guarantee. Source connect_retries is zero. Transfers add no notes and preserve already recorded promises. No HTTP request or hosted execution occurred.
